Franchise.title: Franchise
Franchise.description: Represents a franchise within the pool cleaning and maintenance business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Franchise entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to User representing the owner of this franchise. (Relationship: User 1:1 Franchise)

details.description: Additional details or notes about the franchise.

configuration.description: JSON configuration data for the franchise.

logoUrl.description: URL for the franchise's logo image.

pixKey.description: PIX key for the franchise to receive payments.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the system, regardless of their role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to Franchise to which the user belongs. Null if the user is a master user. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N User)

role.description: The role of the user (master, owner, technician, client).

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL for the user's profile picture.

isActive.description: Whether the user account is active.

Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client of a franchise. A client can have multiple service locations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to Franchise to which the client belongs. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N Client)

userId.description: Reference to the User auth object for this client, if they have portal access.

name.description: The name of the client (individual or company).

contactName.description: The name of the primary contact person for the client.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the client.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the client.

avatarUrl.description: URL for the client's profile picture.

monthlyFee.description: The monthly fee charged to the client.

dueDay.description: The day of the month the payment is due (1-31).

isActive.description: Whether the client is currently active.

ServiceLocation.title: ServiceLocation
ServiceLocation.description: Represents a specific address where service is provided for a client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service location.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client this location belongs to.

franchiseId.description: Reference to the Franchise this location belongs to.

poolDetails.description: Specific details about the pool at this location.

technicianId.description: ID of the technician assigned to this location.

serviceDays.description: Days of the week for recurring service.

Technician.title: Technician
Technician.description: Represents a technician employed by a franchise.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Technician entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to Franchise to which the technician belongs. (Relationship: Franchise 1:N Technician)

firstName.description: The first name of the technician.

lastName.description: The last name of the technician.

location.description: Current location coordinates of the technician (e.g., latitude, longitude).

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents an appointment scheduled for a client at a specific service location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Appointment entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to Franchise to which the appointment belongs.

clientId.description: Reference to Client for whom the appointment is scheduled.

locationId.description: Reference to the ServiceLocation for this appointment.

technicianId.description: Reference to Technician assigned to the appointment.

scheduledDateTime.description: The date and time the appointment is scheduled for.

status.description: The status of the appointment (e.g., scheduled, in progress, completed, cancelled).

ServiceReport.title: ServiceReport
ServiceReport.description: Represents a service report generated for an appointment.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ServiceReport entity.

franchiseId.description: Reference to Franchise to which the service report belongs.

appointmentId.description: Reference to Appointment for which the service report was generated.

technicianId.description: Reference to Technician who created the service report.

clientId.description: Reference to Client for this service report.

locationId.description: Reference to the ServiceLocation for this service report.

missingProducts.description: List of products that are out of stock.

observations.description: Additional notes or comments about the service.

photoUrls.description: Array of URLs pointing to photos taken during the service.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Represents a price quote for services offered to a client or prospect.

franchiseId.description: The ID of the franchise that created the quote.

clientId.description: The ID of the existing client, if applicable.

clientName.description: Client's name (for new or existing clients).

items.description: List of services or products being quoted.

service.description: Name of the service or product.

price.description: Price of the service or product.

totalValue.description: The total value of the quote.

UniversityVideo.title: UniversityVideo
UniversityVideo.description: Represents an educational video for the University Pool feature.

description.description: A brief description of the video content.

videoUrl.description: The URL of the video (e.g., from YouTube).

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL of the video's thumbnail image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the video was posted.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a monthly payment record for a client.

franchiseId.description: The ID of the franchise this payment belongs to.

clientId.description: The ID of the client this payment is for.

dueDate.description: The date the payment is due.

paidAt.description: The date the payment was made.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure Authorization Independence, clarity, and scalability for the Pool BR Limpeza e Manutenção application. It leverages structural segregation and denormalization to simplify security rules and support efficient data access patterns. The structure is heavily influenced by the need to manage Franchises and the Users that are part of them.

**Key Design Choices & Justifications:**

1.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}:** This collection stores the Franchise entities. It is the top-level entity, with Franchises containing Users, Clients, Technicians, Appointments, and Service Reports.
2.  **/users/{userId}:** This top-level collection stores all User entities, regardless of their franchise. This is a critical change to simplify role-based access control and user management, particularly for franchise owners. The user document contains the `franchiseId` and their `role`.
3.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/clients/{clientId}:** This subcollection stores Client entities. The `franchiseId` in the path establishes the relationship.
4.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/locations/{locationId}:** A new sub-collection to handle multiple service addresses for a single client, each with its own QR code target.
5.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/technicians/{technicianId}:** This subcollection stores Technician entities. The `franchiseId` in the path establishes the relationship.
6.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/appointments/{appointmentId}:** This subcollection stores Appointment entities. These represent manually created or edited appointments and override any auto-generated ones for a specific day and location.
7.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/serviceReports/{serviceReportId}:** This subcollection stores ServiceReport entities. The `franchiseId` in the path establishes the relationship.
8.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/quotes/{quoteId}:** This subcollection stores Quote entities. The `franchiseId` in the path establishes the relationship, allowing franchise owners to manage their own quotes.
9.  **/franchises/{franchiseId}/payments/{paymentId}:** This is a new subcollection to store payment records. It allows franchise owners to manage all payments in one place, simplifying queries for financial reporting.
10.  **/universityVideos/{videoId}:** This is a new top-level collection to store educational videos. It's a global resource managed by master users and viewable by all authenticated users, so it doesn't belong under any specific franchise.

**Authorization Independence:**
*   Authorization is primarily based on checking the `role` and `franchiseId` fields within the `/users/{userId}` document. For example, the `isFranchiseOwner` function can now reliably check a single user document to authorize actions across all franchise-related subcollections.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
*   **Structural Segregation:** The use of subcollections for franchise-specific data remains a core principle. This simplifies security rules and prevents the need to filter data within a large collection. For example, all documents within `/franchises/{franchiseId}/clients` belong to that franchise and can be secured with a single rule checking for ownership.
